name: razor

definition.en: a tool with a very sharp blade for shaving
definition.tr: tıraş olmak için çok keskin bıçaklı alet
definition.de: ein Gerät mit sehr scharfer Klinge zum Rasieren
definition.fr: un instrument à lame très tranchante pour se raser
definition.it: un attrezzo con lama molto affilata per radersi
definition.es: un utensilio de hoja muy afilada para afeitarse

origin: Old French rasour, from raser (to shave) ← Latin rādere (to scrape)
